resources.string: When it matters, reach the people who matter. Send a loud alert, your location, and a little context.
You choose your circle. Only people you approve can become trusted contacts.
Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
Add the number your trusted contacts should use in an emergency.
Use your own Indian mobile number. This number is shared with your trusted circle.
Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
This number is already linked to another account.
Set up alerts, location, and voice messages now so they are available when you need them. Android will ask you to allow each permission.
When you send an SOS, your current or recent location can help your trusted contacts find you. Location is only requested while you use the app to send an alert.
Record a five-second message when you choose. It is uploaded to Cloudinary and shared by a link with your alert recipients. The microphone is never used for background recording.
You choose what to allow. You can continue without granting access and change your choices later in Settings.
Allow notifications to see emergency alerts and trusted-contact requests. Notifications must be enabled for the incoming siren to start.
Android manages these permissions in separate settings screens. You can enable them now, then return here to continue.
Notifications are off. You can enable them in Android Settings to receive visible emergency alerts.

These permissions help your trusted contacts reach you and let you share your location or a voice message in an emergency. With some access turned off, incoming alerts may be silent or hidden, and location or voice notes may be unavailable. You can still use the app and enable access later in Settings.
Stay close, even from a distance.
Send an emergency alert to your trusted circle.
Your message will travel with your next alert.

Allow microphone access to record a voice message.

The people you can count on.
Add a family member or friend. Once they accept, you can send each other emergency alerts.

Request sent. They will appear in your circle after accepting.

Incoming alerts will still appear and vibrate. Choose how long to pause the siren.
You will stop receiving SOS alerts on this device until you sign in again. Your scam protection stays configured on this phone.
You’re offline. Local pattern and file checks remain available; online URL reputation and SOS delivery need a connection.
I need your help. Please call me as soon as you can.%1$s

The alert could not be sent.
The service did not confirm your alert in time. It may already have been sent. Retry checks the same alert without sending it twice.
Could not connect to the alert service. Check your connection and try again.
The alert could not start before the time limit. Please try again.
Your alert is still processing. Wait a moment, then retry to check its status.
The alert service returned an error. Delivery is not confirmed. Wait a moment, then retry to check the same alert.
The alert service rejected this request. Please check your account and contact details.
This recording has expired. Record a new message and send the alert again.

Check in with them as soon as you can.

This contact is no longer available for alerts. Check your Circle and their permission to receive alerts.
Your session has expired. Sign out and sign in again.
The alert is still processing, or your contact needs to open Root Security. Wait a moment before retrying. If an attached recording has expired, record a new message.
Too many alerts were sent recently. Wait a minute before retrying.
Confirmation is taking longer than expected. Your change may still sync when the connection returns. Check the list before trying again.
The server needs an update before this action can work.
Too many requests were sent recently. Wait a minute before trying again.

Check suspicious messages, links and files before you act.
Check a message, link or file
Local pattern checks are loading. Google URL threat checks also need online setup and an internet connection.
The message and link models could not load. Try loading them again before relying on automatic checks.
Manual scans are still available. Resume automatic checks in protection settings.
Choose your language and review access for message previews and scam warnings. You can scan manually now.
Allow notification access to check supported SMS and WhatsApp previews as they arrive.
Access is allowed, but Android has not connected the notification listener. Open protection setup to reconnect.
Message preview checks are running, but warning notifications are limited. Review notification access and channels.
Supported SMS and WhatsApp previews can be checked. Google URL checks require online setup below. Hidden previews and unopened messages cannot be scanned.
Paste a message or link, or choose a downloaded file for a risk check.
Local patterns and file inspection work offline. URL threat checks need online setup. No match does not guarantee safety.
Bring your family into the loop
Set a private family code word and choose a guardian. Guardian SMS is optional, needs your consent and carrier service, and may incur charges.
Protection history stays encrypted on this phone. Optional Google checks send URL hash prefixes, not message text. Family SOS uses separate cloud services to reach your trusted contacts.
